verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents multiple concrete multi-agent mechanisms: sub-agents for parallel background runs, a Swarm/Code Mode API for orchestrating concurrent sub-agents with bounded fan-out and structured results, a multi-agent Gateway mode for isolated agent instances, and an A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol channel for external agent-to-agent task delegation. A community post independently corroborates running multiple (9) agents from one machine for real parallel work. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks of actual parallel task throughput/reliability and real-world verification that the A2A protocol interoperates with third-party agents in production.
